package courseplan

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	domainservice "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain/service"
)

// Reconstruct the processor from only the repository's retained retry state.
// Course succeeded before Student went down; the learner changed in between.
func TestPinnedPlanRetryKeepsGeneratedCourseFingerprintAfterLearnerChanges(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 1, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	requests := &processorRequestRepository{claimed: planningRequest(now)}
	student := &changingMasteryStudent{processorStudentService: &processorStudentService{profile: testPlanningProfile(), assignmentErr: errors.New("assignment outage")}}
	course := &recordingCheckpointCourse{processorCourseService: &processorCourseService{result: domain.EnsureCourseResult{CourseID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", Lessons: []domain.CourseLessonBinding{{LessonID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", Order: 0}}}}}
	p := testProcessor(now, requests, student.processorStudentService, course.processorCourseService)
	p.Students, p.Courses = student, course
	if processed, err := p.ProcessNext(context.Background()); !processed || err == nil || requests.retried == nil || course.calls != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("first attempt did not reach Course partial success and persisted retry: processed=%v err=%v", processed, err)
	}
	first := *requests.retried
	var original domain.GeneratedCourse
	if err := json.Unmarshal(first.GeneratedCourseJSON, &original); err != nil || original.Fingerprint == "" {
		t.Fatalf("retained generated Course: %v", err)
	}
	requests.claimed = first
	student.assignmentErr = nil
	student.profile.PreferredLanguage = "en"
	student.masterFirst = true
	reconstructed := testProcessor(now.Add(time.Second), requests, student.processorStudentService, course.processorCourseService)
	reconstructed.Students, reconstructed.Courses = student, course
	if processed, err := reconstructed.ProcessNext(context.Background()); !processed || err != nil || requests.completed == nil {
		t.Fatalf("reconstructed retry: processed=%v err=%v", processed, err)
	}
	if requests.completed.CourseFingerprint != original.Fingerprint || string(requests.completed.NormalizedContextJSON) != string(first.NormalizedContextJSON) || student.created.CourseFingerprint != original.Fingerprint {
		t.Fatalf("old generated Course paired with newer planning identity: Course=%s persisted=%s Student=%s old_context=%s new_context=%s", original.Fingerprint, requests.completed.CourseFingerprint, student.created.CourseFingerprint, first.NormalizedContextJSON, requests.completed.NormalizedContextJSON)
	}
}

type changingMasteryStudent struct {
	*processorStudentService
	masterFirst bool
}

func (s *changingMasteryStudent) QueryMastery(ctx context.Context, studentID string, targets []domain.TargetRef) ([]domain.TargetMastery, error) {
	items, err := s.processorStudentService.QueryMastery(ctx, studentID, targets)
	if s.masterFirst && len(items) > 0 {
		items[0].State = domain.MasteryMastered
		items[0].Confidence = 1
		items[0].MasteryScore = 1
	}
	return items, err
}

type recordingCheckpointCourse struct {
	*processorCourseService
	drafts []domain.GeneratedCourse
}

func (s *recordingCheckpointCourse) EnsureCourse(ctx context.Context, draft domain.GeneratedCourse, key string) (domain.EnsureCourseResult, error) {
	s.drafts = append(s.drafts, draft)
	return s.processorCourseService.EnsureCourse(ctx, draft, key)
}

func (r *processorRequestRepository) GetPlanningInput(_ context.Context, request domain.CoursePlanRequest) (domain.PlanningInputCheckpoint, error) {
	if r.pinReadErr != nil {
		return domain.PlanningInputCheckpoint{}, r.pinReadErr
	}
	if r.planningInput == nil {
		return domain.PlanningInputCheckpoint{}, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return *r.planningInput, r.planningInput.Validate(request)
}
func (r *processorRequestRepository) CheckpointPlanningInput(_ context.Context, request domain.CoursePlanRequest, input domain.PlanningInputCheckpoint, _ time.Time) error {
	r.planningPinCalls++
	if err := input.Validate(request); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if r.pinErr == nil || r.persistPinOnErr {
		cloned := cloneCheckpoint(input)
		r.planningInput = &cloned
	}
	if r.loseLeaseAfter == "input" {
		r.renewErr = domain.ErrConflict
	}
	return r.pinErr
}
func (r *processorRequestRepository) GetGeneratedCourse(_ context.Context, _ domain.CoursePlanRequest) (domain.GeneratedCourseCheckpoint, error) {
	if r.artifactReadErr != nil {
		return domain.GeneratedCourseCheckpoint{}, r.artifactReadErr
	}
	if r.generatedCheckpoint == nil {
		return domain.GeneratedCourseCheckpoint{}, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return *r.generatedCheckpoint, nil
}
func (r *processorRequestRepository) CheckpointGeneratedCourse(_ context.Context, _ domain.CoursePlanRequest, artifact domain.GeneratedCourseCheckpoint, _ time.Time) error {
	r.artifactPinCalls++
	if r.artifactErr == nil || r.persistArtifactOnErr {
		cloned := cloneCheckpoint(artifact)
		r.generatedCheckpoint = &cloned
	}
	if r.loseLeaseAfter == "artifact" {
		r.renewErr = domain.ErrConflict
	}
	return r.artifactErr
}
func (r *processorRequestRepository) GetCourseEnsure(_ context.Context, _ domain.CoursePlanRequest) (domain.CourseEnsureCheckpoint, error) {
	if r.ensureReadErr != nil {
		return domain.CourseEnsureCheckpoint{}, r.ensureReadErr
	}
	if r.ensureCheckpoint == nil {
		return domain.CourseEnsureCheckpoint{}, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return *r.ensureCheckpoint, nil
}
func (r *processorRequestRepository) CheckpointCourseEnsure(_ context.Context, _ domain.CoursePlanRequest, receipt domain.CourseEnsureCheckpoint, _ time.Time) error {
	r.ensurePinCalls++
	if r.ensureErr == nil || r.persistEnsureOnErr {
		cloned := cloneCheckpoint(receipt)
		r.ensureCheckpoint = &cloned
	}
	if r.loseLeaseAfter == "receipt" {
		r.renewErr = domain.ErrConflict
	}
	return r.ensureErr
}
func cloneCheckpoint[T any](input T) T {
	raw, err := json.Marshal(input)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	var output T
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &output); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	return output
}

func checkpointFixture(now time.Time) (*processorRequestRepository, *processorStudentService, *processorCourseService, Processor) {
	r := &processorRequestRepository{claimed: planningRequest(now)}
	s := &processorStudentService{profile: testPlanningProfile()}
	c := &processorCourseService{result: domain.EnsureCourseResult{CourseID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", Lessons: []domain.CourseLessonBinding{{LessonID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444"}}}}
	return r, s, c, testProcessor(now, r, s, c)
}

type checkpointGenerator struct {
	calls    int
	failAt   int
	keys     []string
	contexts []string
}

func (g *checkpointGenerator) GenerateLesson(ctx context.Context, input domainservice.LessonGenerationInput, key string) (domainservice.GeneratedLessonContent, error) {
	g.calls++
	g.keys = append(g.keys, key)
	raw, _ := json.Marshal(input.CourseContext)
	g.contexts = append(g.contexts, string(raw))
	if g.calls == g.failAt {
		return domainservice.GeneratedLessonContent{}, errors.New("provider outage")
	}
	return (processorContentGenerator{}).GenerateLesson(ctx, input, key)
}

func TestPinnedCheckpointsStopEffectsBeforeDurableBoundary(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 1, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	for _, stage := range []string{"input", "artifact", "receipt"} {
		t.Run(stage, func(t *testing.T) {
			r, s, c, p := checkpointFixture(now)
			g := &checkpointGenerator{}
			p.Generator = g
			outage := errors.New("checkpoint write unavailable")
			switch stage {
			case "input":
				r.pinErr = outage
			case "artifact":
				r.artifactErr = outage
			case "receipt":
				r.ensureErr = outage
			}
			processed, err := p.ProcessNext(context.Background())
			if !processed || !errors.Is(err, outage) || s.assignmentCalls != 0 || s.createCalls != 0 || r.completed != nil {
				t.Fatalf("checkpoint outage crossed Student boundary: err=%v student=%#v", err, s)
			}
			if stage == "input" && (g.calls != 0 || c.calls != 0) {
				t.Fatal("generation before durable first input")
			}
			if stage == "artifact" && (g.calls == 0 || c.calls != 0) {
				t.Fatal("Course before durable generated artifact")
			}
			if stage == "receipt" && c.calls != 1 {
				t.Fatal("receipt case did not reach successful Course ensure")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestPinnedReconstructionAfterAmbiguousCheckpointCommits(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 1, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	for _, stage := range []string{"input", "artifact", "receipt"} {
		t.Run(stage, func(t *testing.T) {
			r, s, c, p := checkpointFixture(now)
			g := &checkpointGenerator{}
			p.Generator = g
			outage := errors.New("response lost after durable checkpoint")
			switch stage {
			case "input":
				r.pinErr = outage
				r.persistPinOnErr = true
			case "artifact":
				r.artifactErr = outage
				r.persistArtifactOnErr = true
			case "receipt":
				r.ensureErr = outage
				r.persistEnsureOnErr = true
			}
			if _, err := p.ProcessNext(context.Background()); !errors.Is(err, outage) {
				t.Fatalf("first checkpoint boundary: %v", err)
			}
			input := cloneCheckpoint(*r.planningInput)
			callsBefore := g.calls
			s.profile.PreferredLanguage = "en"
			s.allMastered = true
			r.pinErr = nil
			r.artifactErr = nil
			r.ensureErr = nil
			rebuilt := testProcessor(now.Add(time.Second), r, s, c)
			rebuilt.Generator = g
			rebuilt.Graphs = &countingGraphRepository{}
			rebuilt.Policies = &countingPolicyRepository{}
			if _, err := rebuilt.ProcessNext(context.Background()); err != nil || r.completed == nil {
				t.Fatalf("resume committed %s: %v", stage, err)
			}
			if s.profileCalls != 1 || s.masteryCalls != 1 || r.planningPinCalls != 1 || r.completed.CourseFingerprint != input.Fingerprint || string(r.completed.NormalizedContextJSON) != string(input.NormalizedContext) {
				t.Fatalf("reconstructed first decision drifted: student=%#v result=%#v", s, r.completed)
			}
			if stage != "input" && g.calls != callsBefore {
				t.Fatal("durable generated artifact called provider again")
			}
			if c.calls != 1 {
				t.Fatalf("durable receipt was re-ensured: calls=%d", c.calls)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestPinnedPartialGenerationReplaysSameKeysAndFirstInput(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 1, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	r, s, c, p := checkpointFixture(now)
	g := &checkpointGenerator{failAt: 2}
	p.Generator = g
	if _, err := p.ProcessNext(context.Background()); err == nil || r.retried == nil || r.planningInput == nil || r.generatedCheckpoint != nil || c.calls != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("partial generation escaped boundary: err=%v repo=%#v", err, r)
	}
	original := cloneCheckpoint(*r.planningInput)
	s.profile.PreferredLanguage = "en"
	s.allMastered = true
	rebuilt := testProcessor(now.Add(time.Second), r, s, c)
	rebuilt.Generator = g
	if _, err := rebuilt.ProcessNext(context.Background()); err != nil || r.completed == nil {
		t.Fatalf("partial-generation retry: %v", err)
	}
	if len(g.keys) != 4 || g.keys[0] != g.keys[2] || g.keys[1] != g.keys[3] || g.contexts[0] != g.contexts[2] || g.contexts[1] != g.contexts[3] || r.completed.CourseFingerprint != original.Fingerprint || s.profileCalls != 1 || s.masteryCalls != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("partial generation reinterpreted pinned lesson identity: %#v", g)
	}
}

func TestPinnedExactPathRetainsOriginalExpectedVersionBeforeCommandCheckpoint(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 1, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	r, s, c, p := checkpointFixture(now)
	r.claimed.Intent.Reason = domain.PlanningReasonReplan
	r.claimed.LearningPathID = "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777"
	s.assignmentErr = errors.New("assignment unavailable")
	if _, err := p.ProcessNext(context.Background()); err == nil || r.retried == nil || r.planningInput == nil || r.checkpointed != nil {
		t.Fatalf("first partial Course attempt: %v", err)
	}
	s.planningState = processorPlanningState(r.claimed.StudentID, r.claimed.LearningPathID, r.claimed.GoalCode)
	s.planningState.PathVersion = 99
	s.assignmentErr = nil
	s.replanErr = domain.ErrConflict
	rebuilt := testProcessor(now.Add(time.Second), r, s, c)
	if _, err := rebuilt.ProcessNext(context.Background()); err == nil || r.failureCode != domain.CoursePlanFailurePathConflict || s.replan.ExpectedVersion != 3 || s.planningStateCalls != 1 || c.calls != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("stale pinned replan rebased: err=%v replan=%#v failure=%s", err, s.replan, r.failureCode)
	}
}

func TestPinnedNoGapRetainsOriginalDecisionAfterFailedTerminalWrite(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 1, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	r, s, c, p := checkpointFixture(now)
	s.allMastered = true
	r.completeErr = errors.New("terminal unavailable")
	if _, err := p.ProcessNext(context.Background()); err == nil || r.planningInput == nil {
		t.Fatalf("first no-gap decision: %v", err)
	}
	s.allMastered = false
	s.profile.PreferredLanguage = "en"
	r.completeErr = nil
	rebuilt := testProcessor(now.Add(time.Second), r, s, c)
	if _, err := rebuilt.ProcessNext(context.Background()); err != nil || r.completed == nil || r.completed.ResultCode != domain.CoursePlanResultNoGap || c.calls != 0 || s.createCalls != 0 || s.masteryCalls != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("no-gap retry reinterpreted input: %v", err)
	}
}

func TestPinnedReadTamperAndLegacyGeneratedDraftFailClosed(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 1, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	for _, kind := range []string{"input", "artifact", "receipt", "legacy"} {
		t.Run(kind, func(t *testing.T) {
			r, s, c, p := checkpointFixture(now)
			if kind == "legacy" {
				r.claimed.GeneratedCourseJSON = json.RawMessage(`{"course_fingerprint":"old"}`)
			} else {
				s.assignmentErr = errors.New("assignment unavailable")
				if _, err := p.ProcessNext(context.Background()); err == nil || r.ensureCheckpoint == nil {
					t.Fatalf("prepare pinned partial success: %v", err)
				}
				s.assignmentErr = nil
				switch kind {
				case "input":
					r.planningInput.Profile.PreferredLanguage = "en"
				case "artifact":
					r.generatedCheckpoint.Course.Title = "tampered"
				case "receipt":
					r.ensureCheckpoint.Result.CourseID = "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555"
				}
			}
			assignments := s.assignmentCalls
			creates := s.createCalls
			ensures := c.calls
			rebuilt := testProcessor(now.Add(time.Second), r, s, c)
			if _, err := rebuilt.ProcessNext(context.Background()); err == nil || r.failed == nil || r.completed != nil || s.assignmentCalls != assignments || s.createCalls != creates || c.calls != ensures {
				t.Fatalf("tampered %s produced effects: err=%v", kind, err)
			}
			if kind == "legacy" && r.failureCode != "LEGACY_GENERATED_COURSE_UNBOUND" {
				t.Fatalf("legacy draft guessed provenance: %s", r.failureCode)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestPinnedLeaseLossStopsAtEachDownstreamBoundary(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 1, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	for _, stage := range []string{"input", "artifact", "receipt"} {
		t.Run(stage, func(t *testing.T) {
			r, s, c, p := checkpointFixture(now)
			g := &checkpointGenerator{}
			p.Generator = g
			r.loseLeaseAfter = stage
			if _, err := p.ProcessNext(context.Background()); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict) {
				t.Fatalf("lost lease at %s: %v", stage, err)
			}
			if r.retried != nil || r.failed != nil || r.completed != nil || s.assignmentCalls != 0 || s.createCalls != 0 {
				t.Fatal("stale worker crossed Student/state boundary")
			}
			if stage == "input" && (g.calls != 0 || c.calls != 0) {
				t.Fatal("stale worker generated after pin")
			}
			if stage == "artifact" && c.calls != 0 {
				t.Fatal("stale worker ensured after artifact")
			}
		})
	}
}

type pinnedInitialAllocationRepository struct {
	checkpoint     *domain.InitialAllocationCheckpoint
	checkpointErr  error
	persistOnError bool
	calls          int
}

func (r *pinnedInitialAllocationRepository) GetInitialAllocation(context.Context, domain.CoursePlanRequest) (domain.InitialAllocationCheckpoint, error) {
	if r.checkpoint == nil {
		return domain.InitialAllocationCheckpoint{}, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return *r.checkpoint, nil
}
func (r *pinnedInitialAllocationRepository) CheckpointInitialAllocation(_ context.Context, _ domain.CoursePlanRequest, c domain.InitialAllocationCheckpoint, _ time.Time) error {
	r.calls++
	if r.checkpointErr == nil || r.persistOnError {
		cloned := cloneCheckpoint(c)
		r.checkpoint = &cloned
	}
	return r.checkpointErr
}
func (*pinnedInitialAllocationRepository) ResumeDiagnosticPlanning(context.Context, string, string, time.Time) (domain.CoursePlanRequest, error) {
	return domain.CoursePlanRequest{}, errors.New("unused")
}

func TestPinnedDiagnosticRetryRetainsOriginalOnboardingDirectionFence(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 1, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	r, s, c, p := checkpointFixture(now)
	r.claimed.Intent.Source = domain.PlanningSourceTeacher
	r.claimed.DiagnosticPlanID = "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
	s.profile = diagnosticProfile(1)
	record := diagnosticRecordForCoursePlan(t, r.claimed.StudentID, r.claimed.DiagnosticPlanID)
	diagnostic := &diagnosticProcessorRepository{plan: record, placement: diagnosticPlacementForCoursePlan(t, record.Plan)}
	allocations := &pinnedInitialAllocationRepository{checkpointErr: errors.New("allocation checkpoint outage")}
	p.DiagnosticPlans = diagnostic
	p.DiagnosticPlacements = diagnostic
	p.InitialAllocations = allocations
	if _, err := p.ProcessNext(context.Background()); err == nil || r.ensureCheckpoint == nil || s.assignmentCalls != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("diagnostic partial Course attempt: %v", err)
	}
	s.profile.OnboardingVersion = 2
	s.profile.DirectionCode = "frontend"
	s.createErr = domain.ErrDiagnosticContextStale
	allocations.checkpointErr = nil
	diagnostic.planErr = errors.New("must not reread diagnostic")
	diagnostic.placementErr = diagnostic.planErr
	rebuilt := testProcessor(now.Add(time.Second), r, s, c)
	rebuilt.DiagnosticPlans = diagnostic
	rebuilt.DiagnosticPlacements = diagnostic
	rebuilt.InitialAllocations = allocations
	if _, err := rebuilt.ProcessNext(context.Background()); err == nil || r.failureCode != "DIAGNOSTIC_PLAN_INVALID" || s.created.ExpectedOnboardingVersion != 1 || s.created.ExpectedDirectionCode != "backend" || s.profileCalls != 1 || s.masteryCalls != 1 || diagnostic.planCalls != 1 || diagnostic.placementCalls != 1 || c.calls != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("diagnostic original fence refreshed: err=%v replacement=%#v", err, s.created)
	}
}

func TestPinnedStudentCheckpointReplayRestoresFirstAuditAfterCrash(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 1, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	for _, kind := range []string{"initial", "replan"} {
		t.Run(kind, func(t *testing.T) {
			r, s, c, p := checkpointFixture(now)
			outage := errors.New("response lost after command checkpoint commit")
			allocations := &pinnedInitialAllocationRepository{checkpointErr: outage, persistOnError: true}
			if kind == "initial" {
				r.claimed.Intent.Source = domain.PlanningSourceTeacher
				r.claimed.DiagnosticPlanID = "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
				s.profile = diagnosticProfile(1)
				record := diagnosticRecordForCoursePlan(t, r.claimed.StudentID, r.claimed.DiagnosticPlanID)
				diagnostic := &diagnosticProcessorRepository{plan: record, placement: diagnosticPlacementForCoursePlan(t, record.Plan)}
				p.DiagnosticPlans = diagnostic
				p.DiagnosticPlacements = diagnostic
				p.InitialAllocations = allocations
			} else {
				r.claimed.Intent.Reason = domain.PlanningReasonReplan
				r.claimed.LearningPathID = "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777"
				r.checkpointErr = outage
				r.persistCheckpointOnErr = true
			}
			if _, err := p.ProcessNext(context.Background()); !errors.Is(err, outage) || r.retried != nil || r.completed != nil {
				t.Fatalf("crash checkpoint boundary: %v", err)
			}
			original := cloneCheckpoint(*r.planningInput)
			// Job audit headers may be absent or stale at this crash boundary; the
			// durable private input remains authoritative, while the command is fixed.
			r.claimed.CourseFingerprint = ""
			r.claimed.NormalizedContextJSON = nil
			allocations.checkpointErr = nil
			r.checkpointErr = nil
			s.profile.PreferredLanguage = "en"
			s.allMastered = true
			rebuilt := testProcessor(now.Add(time.Second), r, s, c)
			rebuilt.InitialAllocations = allocations
			if _, err := rebuilt.ProcessNext(context.Background()); err != nil || r.completed == nil {
				t.Fatalf("checkpoint reconstruction: %v", err)
			}
			if r.completed.CourseFingerprint != original.Fingerprint || string(r.completed.NormalizedContextJSON) != string(original.NormalizedContext) || s.profileCalls != 1 || s.masteryCalls != 1 || c.calls != 1 {
				t.Fatalf("Student command replay lost original audit: result=%#v", r.completed)
			}
			if kind == "initial" && (allocations.calls != 1 || s.created.CourseFingerprint != original.Fingerprint || s.created.ExpectedOnboardingVersion != 1) {
				t.Fatal("initial checkpoint body rebuilt")
			}
			if kind == "replan" && (r.checkpointCalls != 1 || s.replan.CourseFingerprint != original.Fingerprint || s.replan.ExpectedVersion != 3) {
				t.Fatal("path checkpoint body rebuilt")
			}
		})
	}
}

type mutableCheckpointGraph struct {
	graph domain.GoalGraph
	calls int
}

func (g *mutableCheckpointGraph) GetPublishedGoalGraph(context.Context, string) (domain.GoalGraph, error) {
	g.calls++
	return g.graph, nil
}

type mutableCheckpointPolicy struct {
	policy domain.PolicyBundle
	calls  int
}

func (p *mutableCheckpointPolicy) GetActivePolicyBundle(context.Context) (domain.PolicyBundle, error) {
	p.calls++
	return p.policy, nil
}

func TestPinnedRetryKeepsFirstGraphAndPolicyAfterPublishedVersionsChange(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 1, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	r, s, c, p := checkpointFixture(now)
	graphs := &mutableCheckpointGraph{graph: testGoalGraph()}
	policies := &mutableCheckpointPolicy{policy: testPolicyBundle()}
	p.Graphs = graphs
	p.Policies = policies
	s.assignmentErr = errors.New("assignment outage")
	if _, err := p.ProcessNext(context.Background()); err == nil || r.retried == nil {
		t.Fatalf("partial Course success: %v", err)
	}
	first := cloneCheckpoint(*r.planningInput)
	graphs.graph.Goal.GraphVersion = "graph-v2"
	graphs.graph.Goal.Title = "Changed published goal"
	policies.policy.PlannerVersion = "course-planner-v2"
	policies.policy.GenerationPolicy = "shared-v2"
	s.assignmentErr = nil
	rebuilt := testProcessor(now.Add(time.Second), r, s, c)
	rebuilt.Graphs = graphs
	rebuilt.Policies = policies
	if _, err := rebuilt.ProcessNext(context.Background()); err != nil || r.completed == nil || graphs.calls != 1 || policies.calls != 1 || c.calls != 1 || s.created.PlannerPolicyVersion != first.Policy.PlannerVersion || r.completed.CourseFingerprint != first.Fingerprint || string(r.completed.NormalizedContextJSON) != string(first.NormalizedContext) {
		t.Fatalf("published versions replaced first decision: %v", err)
	}
}
